title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade shower organization with a wall mount basket that keeps soap and bottles within reach in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. This oval combination shower basket is crafted from solid brass with ventilated, rust-proof solid brass wires to support drainage—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount installation helps save space in the shower
- Concealed screw mounting hardware
- Wide variety of designer finish options available, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Product type: Shower basket / shower caddy basket
- Style: Traditional; complements heritage bathroom fixtures
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H; projection 4.13-Inch
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included items: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
